parsed.summary: The patch resolves the issue with OuterRef in exclude() or ~Q() by modifying the as_sql method in ResolvedOuterRef. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of the as_sql method, which might have unintended consequences. The approach seems fragile as it directly modifies the SQL generation without thorough consideration of other potential use cases.
